posts.text: Why did the Reflecting Pool cases blow up?  Thank Brady v. Maryland, a Supreme Court case requiring that any exculpatory information the government has be turned over to the defense.  A Brady violation is a big deal at DOJ (See Justice Manual 9-5.001). ⬇️
